MetaboAnalystR KEGG-specific PSEA independently confirmed the same pathway at raw p 5.41e-09, hitting 6 metabolites across 41 pathway members. Mummichog m/z-direct activity ranked the MUMM:tryptophan_metabolism network as its top hit (p = 0.00160) with 16 of 17 compounds mapped — the highest overlap density of any pathway in the dataset.
